root_cause.text: The nft_counter dump-and-reset operation lacked synchronization, allowing concurrent reset requests to both read the same counter values and subtract them, causing counter underruns.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states "preventing concurrent dump-and-reset from underrunning values" and "two parallel resets cannot both read the same counter values and then both subtract them"; patch adds a spinlock to serialize fetch+reset.
